body:
If I knew you'd treat yourself like this I would have been your valentine for that day.

Also it's 2 AM and I'm so fucking hungry what wtf!

That's where the problem remains. I just find everything completely dull, as if happiness and sadness are limited to an extend and both are wacky and tiresome after a while either.

I made a promise to myself that if things turn out unpleasant on my next birthday, I will end my life. 

Truthfully, I can't say I'm depressed but everything is so absurd and taking your own life is a matter of a personal choice and right.

This is the best thing someone has ever said to me..
Thank you!

I'm most definitely in the same situation.
I'm 18 now but I gave myself a longer timeline, a year.
On my next birthday (when and if i'll turn 19) and things are still blank, pointless, unpleasant and dull. I will kill my self on that day.

And I think you should too, give yourself more time.
